Evidence/CLM-011
Evidence record

The complaint path is documented; there is no evidence yet on how it performs

What does this evidence establish?

A 2024 consumer-protection awareness brochure of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) describes a provider complaint stage of up to 10 business days, a possible extension under conditions it states, and escalation to CBY-Aden within 14 business days after the provider stage ends. These time limits come from the brochure, not from an extracted legal text. Evidence on how complaints are actually handled is not available.

What does it measure?

The complaint and escalation steps, and their time limits, as described in a consumer-protection brochure of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) dated 23 March 2024.

Who or what does it apply to?

Banks and non-bank financial institutions, which the brochure lists as covered

When was it measured or observed?

Brochure dated 23 March 2024; the 2023 Instructions were announced on 28 August 2023

How current is it?

The latest source in this record is the brochure dated 23 March 2024. It should not be read as describing the complaint path at a later date unless a newer official description is published or the legal text of the 2023 Instructions is extracted.

What this evidence does not establish

It does not establish that the complaint system is effective, that complaints are resolved on time in practice, or that it is applied across all covered institutions.

Limits of the measure

The brochure describes the complaint path as its publisher presents it; it is not legal advice and not evidence of compliance or performance. No verified administrative series on complaint volumes, resolution times, enforcement or outcomes is currently available.

Method and verification detailDetail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

The steps and time limits are taken from an official consumer-protection awareness brochure issued by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) on 23 March 2024. The legal text of the Financial Consumer Protection Regulatory Instructions, which CBY-Aden announced on 28 August 2023, has not been extracted in the evidence base.
